toegepas.na: Deeg word brood wanneer jy dit bak
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Bak tot brood' is a stiff resultative construction; the replacement says the same thing in natural Grade 6 Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: 'Deeg bak tot brood' is a compressed resultative construction that reads stiff for a Grade 6 reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal says the same thing in plain, natural Afrikaans, touches no protected wording, and now mirrors the next sentence's 'Brood word nie weer deeg nie'.

vlae.teks: Brood word nie weer deeg nie, maar beton se sand en klippe is net vasgeplak.
vlae.rede: The 'maar' sets concrete against bread right after both are said to form a new material, so a learner may not tell whether concrete counts as a new material or not; clarifying it would mean guessing the intended content, so this is not changed.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: die gaatjies bly op die filter
laat_vaar_vorige.na: die gaatjies, bly op die filter
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A comma after the embedded relative clause separates its verb from the main verb 'bly' (AWS); study text only, not the protected definition.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: An optional comma, and the sentence closely repeats the decided 'filtreer' definition, which has no comma, so the two would stop matching.
